pages.text: [#](53341a)A complete small or medium ritual circle removes the risk carried by casting with no circle. Infernal circles are more dangerous. Keep the altar structure valid before release; a failed delivery validation leaves the brew in the cauldron.[#]()
pages.title: Circles & Covens

pages.text: [#](53341a)Nearby coven witches raise the ritual's permitted strength and extend target reach.[#]()
[#](53341a)Raised land and extended blindness are composed workings: choose the world action or effect reagent, open its capacity, then add ritual delivery and release it from the cauldron.[#]()
